AWS Service Mind Map

AWS Service Mind Map

Study with By exam guide (gaps first), choose between look-alikes in Decide, see whole solutions in Architectures, and look up any service in By service. Open a service for its 5 key lines; the rest is under “More detail”.

How to use this map

By exam guide follows the official SAP-C02 exam guide: the 4 domains with their share of the exam, the 20 task statements with what you must know and do, self-check questions, your quiz result (🟢 known · 🟡 shaky · 🔴 gap) with the key answers, and every service for the task with a one-line explanation; any service shows its task numbers (e.g. "Exam tasks 2.4, 3.4"). By course arranges the same services exactly like your SAP-C02 course, section by section and lecture by lecture (3 Identity & Federation … 17 Other Services), so you can review a lecture right after watching it; in every view a service shows its section and lecture numbers next to its path. By pillar groups the services under the six Well-Architected pillars and their design principles; every service shows its pillar badges (click one to light up all services in that pillar), and the quiz has a Pillars mode. Every service from your SAP-C02 course notes and practice sets. Two ways in: By service when you know the name, By requirement when you only have the question. Search also matches the phrases a question uses, so paste a phrase from the stem (try “cached locally” or “WORM”). Dashed branches are modes — the variants the exam actually asks you to choose between. Click a service to open its knowledge layer: deciding facts (with the reversed trap version), limits and numbers, and what it connects to (red = not a valid connection). Each service also lists what it is often confused with and why those lose, plus constraint badges (ops, set-up time, code change, DR rung). In the question bank shows, for each service, how many of the 676 practice questions test it, how often it is the right answer versus a trap when it is offered, and which questions to open; Most tested and Usual traps light those services up on the map, and faded names never appear in the questions. The quiz has four modes (which service, true/false, look-alikes, numbers) and remembers what you miss in this browser: missed items come back more often, and a coloured dot marks how you did on each service. Exam guide lights up every service in the current SAP-C02 exam guide list (2024.10); each service panel shows its guide category, any name the older v1.0 guide used (Kinesis Data Firehose, AWS SSO, CloudEndure…), and whether it was dropped from the list (Cloud9, CodeStar, CodeCommit, IoT Analytics, Data Pipeline, Alexa for Business). Searching an old or official guide name finds the current service. Retiring marks services AWS has closed to new customers or is shutting down (checked against the AWS maintenance, sunset and shutdown lists on Oct 1, 2026; each badge links its source), and Newer shows recent services not yet in the exam guide. Mountpoint for Amazon S3 and 21 more services the questions use (Marketplace, MemoryDB, Managed Grafana and Prometheus, Amplify, Cloud WAN, Security Lake, AppFabric, Audit Manager, Private CA, DNS Firewall, CloudTrail Lake, Roles Anywhere, Route 53 ARC and others) were added in v12. Must-haves lights up the services almost every AWS architecture should have, in three tiers (organization baseline, workload building blocks, hybrid / many VPCs), each with a line on why. Each service also has a plain-English card (what it should have been called, what you use it for, and what it is like on-premises; idea from AWS in Plain English, wording written for this map), searchable and with its own quiz mode. Service icons are the official AWS Architecture Icons, the same ones used in exam diagrams; a feature that shares its parent's icon shows none, and the Icons button hides them all.
